name: Limit points of Legendre-LP dual-feasible points have density 0
statement: Every limit point of Legendre-LP dual-feasible points is feasible at every real scale and has density 0, psi(t) <= 3 log2 t + 3.

name: Legendre-LP dual feasibility restricts along divisibility chains
statement: Feasibility of a Legendre-LP dual point at qx implies feasibility of its restriction at x.

name: Pointwise bound for the Moebius sum of one fixed cofinal sawtooth remainder
statement: Pointwise polylog bound for sum_k mu(k) r_b(x/k) for one fixed cofinal r_b. Uses the integers and all primes jointly; fails for DH, Liouville and theta^3 at Lambda_a >= 0; not separated from E_a at the level of exponents (returns 1/2 + a); only a mean-square bound is argued (MV-CAP).

name: Vaughan X^(1/4) forcing is a normalisation removable by two linear mollifier conditions
statement: The X^{1/4} Vaughan forcing equals -(4+2gamma) sqrt X M'(1) - zeta'(1/2) M'(1/2) and is removed by two linear conditions on the mollifier; residual |Xi'| <= (U + 32 sqrt U + 25)(6 + log X)/sqrt X.

name: Two-sided bound for the smallest eigenvalue of the Nyman-Beurling Gram matrix
statement: 1/(64*2^Omega_N*N^2) <= lam_min(G_N) <= (3+log N)/(N-1)^2; exponent exactly 2 up to N^o(1); p = 2 open. Same law for DH and periodic non-multiplicative sequences; carries no zero information.

name: Control SEL: twisted Selberg zeta of Gamma(2)
statement: Twisted Selberg zeta of Gamma(2): Euler product over geodesics, s <-> 1-s equation, real exceptional zeros off the line; lacks INT, order one, finite degree, sign of the zero side.

name: Selberg companion in Theorem PC has abscissa sigma* >= 1/2
statement: Any non-negative-coefficient coupling c Z'/Z + E with the PSL2(Z) Selberg zeta has sigma* >= 1/2; Theorem PC is silent at rho/2.

name: m1plus cubic gauss prime sum uniform
statement: (M1+): cancellation in sums of normalised cubic Gauss sums over primes, uniform in the dual index, for the fixed coefficients of the 7/8 method. GRH-type below-level estimate; the single point where arithmetic of the coefficients enters lanes e2-below-level-mixed-moment, e2-ms-slot-capacity, e2-two-scale-detector-moment.

name: z0 charge is lemma 14 2 term l
statement: The '+z_0' charge in the 7/8 manuscript enters through term L of Lemma 14.2 at short dual length, not a triangle-inequality loss (corrects r3-critical-count 5.1).

name: cofinal mobius sum equals x m
statement: For density-0 b >= 0 with log discrepancy, sum_k mu(k) r_b(x/k) form F_b = -c x m(x) + psi_b, 0 <= psi_b = O(log^2 x).

name: ctrl fake genprime unimodular fe
statement: (1-5T+5T^2)/((1-T)(1-5T)), T = 5^-s: Euler product over generalised primes, unimodular parameters, exact functional equation, zero offset 0.29899. Shows the integers cannot be dropped from any local-defect statement.

name: shift reciprocal covariance filter
statement: RZ_b passes every prime-side identity and size inequality after s -> s+1-b, F -> 1/F; a valid argument needs a step not covariant under shift and reciprocal (sign of Lambda, or position of pole/symmetry line).

name: order2 row three conditions
statement: An order-2 row attack needs jointly: Moebius produced by the row, shift 0, coherent set of relative size 1/2. Waldspurger product-index rows give none; square classes give two at shift 1/2.

name: legendre riesz sandwich theorem u
statement: Theta <= min_theta nu^R_k <= Theta + (1-Theta)^2/(k+2-Theta) for the robust (prime-free) Legendre-Riesz LP exponent; upper half uses M(y) << y^(Theta+eps). Refereed once.

name: legendre lp hyperbola pinning
statement: For D >= about 2.2 sqrt X the exact Legendre-Riesz LP equals psi_k(X)/X^k for k=0,1,2 (X up to 1e6 for k=0,1; reproduced at X=2700).

name: ms slot condition is reflected dual length
statement: Lemma 17.1 condition r+2z <= m equals T_d <= F on the reflected dual length of Lemma 14.3 (principal configuration, r+z >= 2m/3, r+3z >= m); the 2z_a comes from mark primes in the reflection conductor.

name: Theta-dual m-series is a twisted stripped sextic Kubota series (target-blind)
statement: On squarefree m the theta-dual m-series of MS (5.3) is an alpha^(-2)-twisted stripped sextic Kubota series in the modulus m at index 4^5 s mu^3. The identity contains no factor depending on the target function: it is the same for every eta and for DH (lane e2-theta-dual-mseries-fe).

name: tro6 dual term lambda c correlation
statement: Non-polar remainder times conj gamma_1(c) correlates with theta estimators at index lambda*c: excess R^2 about 0.25 over permutation null, flat in Q (3750..10607). Origin (theta coefficients vs shared Gauss-sum table) not separated.

name: tro6 lemma s squarefull twist
statement: chi_c(u m1 m2^2 ... t^6) = chi_c(u m1) xi_k(c), xi_k of bounded conductor; row sum stays sextic.

name: saddle pair count saving equivalence
statement: In the estimate system C1-C3 of the 7/8 method, a restricted fourth-moment saving U^-omega at block m* = 0.4183 implies a count saving U^-omega on plain-witness rows; detector-beside-fourth-moment needs > 53%, two-scale 48-49%, one-scale mixed moment 1/6 of the large-sieve-to-Lindelof gap.

name: Control RZ_b: 1/zeta(s + 1 - b), 7/8 < b < 1
statement: RZ_b(s) = 1/zeta(s + 1 - b) = prod_p (1 - p^(b-1) p^-s) = sum mu(n) n^(b-1) n^-s. Log-derivative coefficients -n^(b-1) Lambda(n): a signed twist of Lambda with |eps_n| <= 1 (control TW-). Meromorphic on C, real zero at s = b (the pole of zeta), functional equation about Re s = b - 1/2 instead of 1/2. Has: Euler product, size, support, continuation. Lacks: Lambda >= 0, the integers (coefficients mu(n) n^(b-1)), symmetry line 1/2. Elementary; stated by the engine in batch 2, not refereed. Answers the open item of lane c1-missing-controls (a twist with a zero in 7/8 < Re s < 1); it needs infinitely many primes, as that lane noted.
source: engine batch 2 (merge_outcomes.py STATIC_NODES); follow-up of push/c1-missing-controls

name: Rouche comparison of zeta with a functional-equation-symmetrised Euler stage
statement: Stage zeta_X(s) = P_X(s) + chi(s) conj(P_X(1 - conj s)), P_X an Euler stage over the primes up to X and chi the factor of the functional equation (Gonek 2012 type; recalled, source not opened). The stage satisfies the functional equation by construction, and its zero measure on the line is the phase comb of phi(t) = -2 vartheta(t) - 2 arg P_X(1/2 + it). Proposed device: Rouche comparison of zeta with zeta_X on the boundary of a window through the approximate functional equation, so that the zero count of zeta in the window equals that of the stage. Uses all primes up to X jointly and the functional equation in the same step. Known so far: the k = 0 term of the comb is the explicit-formula density with primes up to X, and its positivity on a window is the sup bound of the truncated prime sum against (1/2) log(t/2 pi), which holds for X of order log^2 t only (round 3, lesson 2); anything further must come from the k != 0 terms or from the comparison. Not established: any Rouche margin. To be checked: the unimodular twist has the same stage theorem and no approximate functional equation; rows G10, Q10 (finite Euler stages without the functional equation are closed); Hamburger uniqueness past the Riemann-Siegel length. Object of lane c4-fe-stage-rouche-crossing (not reported when this node was written).
source: campaign/ROUND_LOG.md, round 4 allocation, lane 3 (c4-fe-stage-rouche-crossing); follows push/c3-twinladder-prime-built-chain

name: Hecke operators compressed to the Lax-Phillips space of the modular surface
statement: Lax-Phillips scattering for PSL(2,Z): the scattering matrix is xi(2s-1)/xi(2s) (classical), so the resonances of the compressed semigroup on K = H minus (D_- + D_+) are at rho/2. Proposed device: compress the Hecke operators T_p to K; a norm bound of the form p^theta + p^-theta with theta < 1/2 on resonance states would bound Re rho. It would use the commuting Hecke family at all primes (an operator-norm statement, so independent of height), and non-arithmetic groups, which have no Hecke family, are a structural control. Not established: no bound is proved; expected first obstacle: T_p does not preserve the incoming and outgoing subspaces D_-, D_+. Related nodes: bridge-scattering-factorisation, antihermitian-strip-bound. The Lax-Phillips rows already closed concern the scattering form of zeta(s-a)/zeta(s+a) with heat-fiber-completion-theorem, not a Hecke compression. Object of lane c4-laxphillips-hecke-compression (not reported when this node was written).

name: Discrepancy rigidity for completely multiplicative unimodular functions (Helson)
statement: Property D(theta) for a completely multiplicative unimodular chi: sum_{n <= x} chi(n) = c x + O(x^theta). It is not a tail property (finite modifications of chi = 1 have discrepancy of order log x; Klurman, recalled, source not opened) and it holds at chi = 1 with theta = 0: the one object found in round 3 that is both non-tail and tied to chi = 1. D(theta) gives the continuation of F(s) - c/(s-1) to Re s > theta, which is data to the left of Re s = 1. Proposed device: D(theta) forces a zero-free region Re s > f(theta) for F with f(0) < 1. Open alternative to be decided: the converse lemma (D(theta) forces the set of primes with chi(p) != 1 to be thin, so F/zeta is zero-free and pole-free on Re s > theta and the implication runs through zeta, circular) or a non-thin example. The proposed control THIN (thin twist) bounds what the implication can give: at best zero-free Re s > theta. Object of lane c4-helson-discrepancy-zerofree (not reported when this node was written).
source: campaign/ROUND_LOG.md, round 3 results (results that could be combined) and round 4 allocation, lane 1 (c4-helson-discrepancy-zerofree); follows push/c3-helson-tail-fe-selector
